spans.s: a. [शिष्-अच्] Remaining, rest, all the other; न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः [[
]]; शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा [[
]]; प्रतिकारविधानमायुषः सति शेषे हि फलाय कल्पते [[

.]] &c. 
___(b) 
__1 Surplus, balance. 
__2 Anything left out or omitted to be said; (

is often used by commentators in supplying an ellipsis or words necessary to complete the construction). 
__3 Escape, salvation, respite. 
-षः 
__1 Result, effect. 
__2 End, termination, conclusion. 
__3 Death, destruction. 
__4 N. of a celebrated serpent, [Page1567-2] said to have one thousand heads, and represented as forming the couch of Viṣṇu or as supporting the entire world on his head; किं शेषस्य भरव्यथा न वपुषि क्ष्मां न क्षिपत्येष यत् [[

.]] 
__5 N. of Balarāma (supposed to be an incarnation of Śeṣa). 
__6 An elephant. 
__7 Subsidiary अङ्ग; something which is declared as being subservient to something else; शेषः परार्थत्वात् [[
[[ŚB. on MS.]]); शेषो हि सादनम् [[ŚB. on

.]] 
__8 Favour (प्रसाद); ‘शेषः संकर्षणे वधे अनन्ते ना प्रसादे च’

.]] 
-षा The remains of flowers or other offerings made to an idol and distributed among the worshippers as a holy relique; तस्यै स्त्रियस्ताः प्रददुः शेषां युयुजुराशिषः [[
]]; तथेति शेषामिव भर्तुराज्ञामादाय मूर्ध्ना मदनः प्रतस्थे [[

]]; [[Ś. 3.]] 
-षम् The remnants of food, remains of an offering. (शेषे is used adverbially in the sense of 
__1 at last, finally. 
__2 in other cases; as in शेषे षष्टी.) 
-Comp. 
-अन्नम् leavings of food. 
-अवस्था old age. 
-कालः the time of death. 
-जातिः f. assimilation of residues; (in alg.) reduction of fractions of residues. 
-पतिः a manager. 
-भागः the remainder. 
-भोजनम् the eating of leavings; गृहस्थस्य … … त्यागः शेषभोजनम् [[Kau.

.]] 
-रात्रिः the last watch of the night. 
-रूपिन् a. appearing to be secondary. 
-शयनः, -शायिन् m. epithets of Viṣṇu.

a. Theistical. 
-Comp. 
-सांख्यम् the theistical branch of the सांख्य school.
